errors.description: Each buttonhole is stitched BESIDE its button, to the sleeve-body side, rather than beneath it. On a working cuff the buttonhole lies under the button on the overlapping vent edge. The drawing does not settle the point — its red marks give position only, not the buttonhole's relationship to the button.
errors.expected: buttonhole placement as a working cuff would carry it
errors.actual: button and buttonhole side by side
errors.correction: Accepted. The drawing does not specify it, the option being sold is the COUNT, and the count and its placement are both exactly right. Recorded rather than waved past.

errors.description: The button column spans a slightly shorter run of sleeve than the drawing does relative to the cuff. The drawn column covers roughly two thirds of the visible sleeve height; here it covers closer to half.
errors.expected: the column spanning as drawn relative to the cuff
errors.correction: Accepted. The render is framed closer than the drawing, so the two spans are not directly comparable, and the spacing between buttons is even and proportionate.

waiver.authority: user decision 2026-07-30: QC gate stays >=98; a 3rd attempt is allowed; after 3 attempts an image with ZERO critical/major findings may ship at >=95 as a LOGGED WAIVER in qc.json

notes:
ATTEMPT 3, and every finding from both earlier attempts is now resolved.

Attempt 1 omitted the sleeve-vent seam entirely and let distractions share the frame. Attempt 2 fixed those but introduced a new fault THAT I CAUSED: I instructed it to leave 'roughly half a sleeve-width' between the lowest button and the cuff edge, a figure I took from the attempt-1 QC note without opening the drawing to check it. It obeyed, and the whole column sat far too high.

Opening 0627__5_flat.jpg directly showed the column runs down close to the hem. This attempt moved it as one unit and centred it on the seam, and both are now correct.

The lesson is a familiar one wearing new clothes: an inherited measurement is not evidence. A number in a prior QC note is a claim, and propagating it into a correction without checking the source cost one generation.

Two minor findings remain, both accepted. Every category is at or above 95 with zero Critical or Major findings, so this qualifies for the logged waiver at attempt 3.
